component.name: Sublayer Player
component.summary: Media player with live captions and live translation to English

description.p: Sublayer Player plays media with standard transport controls and generates live captions on your machine with whisper.cpp. The spoken language is auto-detected; a toggle translates the finalized caption cards to English through bundled Firefox Translations models (Chinese simplified, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Danish, Russian). Everything runs locally; the only network access is downloading the chosen whisper model and the translation bundles on first use, both verified against pinned SHA-256 digests.
Sound is optional by design: playback uses a system helper (pw-cat, paplay, or aplay on PATH) and without one the video and captions keep running silently.
